newsitem.title: UK: Ipswich Port handles first rail freight since 1993.
newsitem.headline: Ipswich Port handles first rail freight since 1993.

text.p: Ipswich Port has handled its first rail-delivered freight traffic since 1993, owner Associated British Ports Holdings Plc said Friday.

ABP said the port handled three separate rail consignments this week totalling 1,110 tonnes of 12 metre steel pipes. The pipes were manufactured at British Steel Plc's Hartlepool plant for export to Houston, Texas.
Ipswich Port Ltd managing director Jon Copping said: "The new trade is a coup for the port and is expected to generate further rail freight business in the near future."
English Welsh & Scottish Railway transported the pipes which each weighed three tonnes.
